mapper.insert: insert into ai_conversation (id, user_id, org_id, title, agent_key, agent_version, agent_release_id, manifest_digest, status, created_at, updated_at) values (#{id}, #{userId}, #{orgId}, #{title}, #{agentKey}, #{agentVersion}, #{agentReleaseId}, #{manifestDigest}, #{status}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: select id, user_id, org_id, title, agent_key, agent_version, agent_release_id, manifest_digest, status, event_cursor, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at from ai_conversation where id = #{id}

select id, user_id, org_id, title, agent_key, agent_version, agent_release_id, manifest_digest, status, event_cursor, created_at, updated_at, last_message_at from ai_conversation where user_id = #{userId} and conversation_kind = 'USER' order by updated_at desc limit #{limit} offset #{offset}
select count(*) from ai_conversation where user_id = #{userId} and conversation_kind = 'USER'
select exists(select 1 from ai_conversation where id = #{id} and conversation_kind = 'A2A_CHILD')
mapper.update: update ai_conversation set updated_at = #{now} where id = #{id}
mapper.select: update ai_conversation set message_seq = message_seq + 1, last_message_at = now(), updated_at = now() where id = #{conversationId} returning message_seq

select id, conversation_id, run_id, role, content, citations, status, seq, created_at, null as usage_json from ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId} and seq > #{afterSeq} order by seq asc limit #{limit}
select count(*) from ai_message where conversation_id = #{conversationId}
mapper.update: update ai_message set content = #{content}, status = #{status} where id = #{messageId}
